harbor.practice: Harbor normalises every policy embedding to length 1 at index time, so the vector store can rank by dot product, which then equals cosine similarity.
harbor.failure: Computing cosine on a zero vector from a failed embedding call: it is undefined. Detect empty or failed embeddings explicitly instead of letting NaN scores reach ranking.

harbor.practice: Harbor's "possible data-leak" detector flags 1 in 2,000 answers with 95% recall and 1% false positives. Bayes says most alerts will be false, so alerts route to a review queue rather than blocking answers automatically.
harbor.failure: Reporting a precise-looking confidence interval from a biased sample: it can be precisely wrong about real traffic.

harbor.practice: When Harbor's reranker is fine-tuned (13.5), the team plots loss for three learning rates on a 2,000-pair sample before committing GPU time to the full run.
harbor.failure: Reading a falling training loss as proof of learning: compare validation loss, which is what generalisation looks like.

harbor.practice: Harbor's reranker training log starts at loss ≈ ln(2) = 0.69 for a binary relevant/irrelevant head, exactly the uniform-guess value. A start far from that number signals a label or setup bug.
harbor.failure: Equating lower token loss with task success: a model can improve perplexity and still fail critical extraction or permission cases.

harbor.practice: Harbor's evaluation notebooks are throwaway; the cleaning and scoring code lives in a versioned package that the CI pipeline runs with pinned dependencies and seeds.
harbor.failure: Fitting normalisation on the full dataset before splitting, or trusting a notebook that only works because of hidden cell order.

harbor.practice: Harbor's developers prototype on laptops with a 3B model in 4-bit (≈ 2 GB). Production serving runs an 8B model in FP8 on datacentre GPUs, and capacity numbers come only from benchmarks on those GPUs.
harbor.failure: Assuming an "8 GB model file" runs in 8 GB of RAM: the KV cache, runtime overhead and the operating system need room too.
